items.stem: Please _____ a copy of your ID with the form.
items.exZh: 請隨表格附上身分證影本。

items.stem: I'm sorry to _____ you, but the concert has been canceled.
items.exZh: 很抱歉讓你失望，演唱會取消了。

items.stem: My dad was _____ when he saw the broken window.
items.exZh: 爸爸看到破掉的窗戶時氣炸了。

items.stem: The _____ for littering is a fine of 1,200 dollars or more.
items.exZh: 亂丟垃圾的罰則是一千二百元以上罰鍰。

items.stem: I _____ my dad to let me get a dog.
items.exZh: 我說服爸爸讓我養狗。

items.stem: The company offers bonuses as an _____ to work harder.
items.exZh: 公司以獎金作為激勵，鼓勵員工更努力。

items.stem: "Break a leg" shouldn't be taken in its _____ sense.
items.exZh: Break a leg 不該照字面意思理解。

items.stem: I had the trousers _____ because they were too long.
items.exZh: 褲子太長，所以我拿去改。

items.stem: In an act of _____, the students refused to wear the uniform.
items.exZh: 學生們拒穿制服以示反抗。

items.stem: The weather can change quickly up there, so dress _____.
items.exZh: 山上天氣變化很快，所以要穿得合宜。

items.stem: Mozart _____ his first piece of music at the age of five.
items.exZh: 莫札特五歲就創作了第一首樂曲。

items.stem: LED bulbs are more _____ than old light bulbs.
items.exZh: LED 燈泡比傳統燈泡更節能。

items.stem: The two companies reached an _____ after months of talks.
items.exZh: 兩家公司在談判數月後達成協議。

items.stem: Don't _____ your skin to strong sunlight for too long.
items.exZh: 皮膚不要長時間暴露在強烈陽光下。

items.stem: He was _____ to tell his parents the truth.
items.exZh: 他不太願意跟父母說實話。

items.stem: Once you sign it, the contract is legally _____.
items.exZh: 合約一經簽署，就具有法律約束力。

items.stem: We didn't _____ so many people coming to the event.
items.exZh: 我們沒料到會有這麼多人來參加活動。

items.stem: I've told you _____ times to lock the door.
items.exZh: 我已經跟你說過無數次要鎖門了。

items.stem: In the _____ of the storm, thousands of homes had no power.
items.exZh: 暴風雨過後，數千戶住家停電。

items.stem: A neutral country agreed to _____ between the two sides.
items.exZh: 一個中立國同意在雙方之間調停。

items.stem: It took us two hours to _____ the new bookshelf.
items.exZh: 我們花了兩小時組裝新書架。

items.stem: The weather this winter has been _____; it has hardly been cold at all.
items.exZh: 今年冬天的天氣很反常，幾乎都不冷。

items.stem: From her smile, I _____ that she had passed the test.
items.exZh: 從她的笑容，我推斷她通過了考試。

items.stem: "Break a leg" is an _____ that means "good luck."
items.exZh: Break a leg 是一個慣用語，意思是「祝好運」。

items.stem: Our neighbor's dog is _____, so stay away from it.
items.exZh: 鄰居的狗很兇，離牠遠一點。

items.stem: Police are trying to _____ the cause of the fire.
items.exZh: 警方正設法查明火災原因。

items.stem: The internet has had a _____ effect on our lives.
items.exZh: 網路對我們的生活產生了深遠的影響。

items.stem: Please take all your _____ with you when you leave the train.
items.exZh: 下車時請帶好您的隨身物品。

items.stem: The new bridge will _____ trade between the two towns.
items.exZh: 新橋將促進兩個小鎮之間的貿易。

items.stem: Please let me know _____ if you can't come.
items.exZh: 如果你不能來，請事先告訴我。

items.stem: Can you _____ how much we spent on the trip?
items.exZh: 你能算出我們這趟旅行花了多少錢嗎？

items.stem: Ten thousand Taiwan dollars is roughly _____ to 300 U.S. dollars.
items.exZh: 一萬元新臺幣大約相當於三百美元。

items.stem: I'm sorry to _____, but there's a phone call for you.
items.exZh: 抱歉打擾，有你的電話。

items.stem: Too much _____ to the sun can damage your skin.
items.exZh: 過度曝曬會傷害皮膚。

items.stem: I was so tired that I could _____ keep my eyes open.
items.exZh: 我累到幾乎睜不開眼睛。

items.stem: The region is _____ by hot summers and mild winters.
items.exZh: 這個地區的特色是夏季炎熱、冬季溫和。

items.stem: There has been no _____ change in his condition.
items.exZh: 他的病情沒有明顯的變化。

items.stem: The teacher _____ her love of music to her students.
items.exZh: 老師把她對音樂的熱愛傳給了學生。

items.stem: The new tax has been a point of _____ for months.
items.exZh: 新稅制已經爭論了好幾個月。

items.stem: Is it _____ to bring food into the museum?
items.exZh: 可以帶食物進博物館嗎？

items.stem: A statue was _____ in the park to honor the hero.
items.exZh: 公園裡立了一座雕像紀念那位英雄。

items.stem: Thirty minutes of _____ exercise a day is good for you.
items.zh: 精力充沛的；強而有力的
items.exZh: 每天三十分鐘的劇烈運動對你有益。

items.stem: Please _____ that all windows are closed before you leave.
items.exZh: 離開前請確認所有窗戶都已關好。

items.stem: He felt a lot of _____ about lying to his friend.
items.exZh: 他對朋友說謊，感到非常內疚。

items.stem: The weather will _____ whether we go hiking or not.
items.exZh: 天氣將決定我們要不要去爬山。

items.stem: Few athletes ever _____ such a high level of skill.
items.exZh: 很少有運動員能達到這麼高的技術水準。

items.stem: The couple reached an _____ agreement about the house.
items.exZh: 這對夫妻就房子問題達成了友好的協議。

items.stem: It is illegal to _____ against workers because of their age.
items.exZh: 因年齡歧視員工是違法的。

items.stem: The speaker opened with an _____ about his first day as a teacher.
items.exZh: 講者以他第一天當老師的趣事作為開場。

items.stem: Some students learn best by listening; _____, others need to see things written down.
items.exZh: 有些學生聽講學得最好；相反地，有些人需要看到文字。

items.stem: Rumors about the new teacher quickly _____ around the school.
items.exZh: 關於新老師的傳言很快在學校傳開。

items.stem: In the story, the _____ fox tricked the crow.
items.exZh: 故事裡，狡猾的狐狸騙了烏鴉。

items.stem: Women _____ more than half of the workers in the factory.
items.exZh: 女性占這家工廠員工的一半以上。

items.stem: This beach is _____ for families with small children.
items.exZh: 這片海灘很適合有小孩的家庭。

items.stem: At street markets, you can often _____ for a lower price.
items.exZh: 在路邊市集，常常可以殺價。

items.stem: It took a few weeks to _____ myself to the new schedule.
items.exZh: 我花了幾週才讓自己習慣新的作息。

items.stem: It would be _____ to drive in this snowstorm.
items.exZh: 在這種暴風雪中開車簡直是瘋了。

items.stem: I made a few _____ to the seat before driving.
items.exZh: 開車前我把座椅稍微調整了一下。

items.stem: He's a _____ driver, though not an exceptional one.
items.exZh: 他是個稱職的駕駛，雖然稱不上出色。

items.stem: Details of the _____ concert will be announced next week.
items.zh: 即將到來的；樂於提供資訊的
items.exZh: 即將舉行的演唱會細節將於下週公布。

items.stem: The teacher _____ us a lot of homework for the weekend.
items.exZh: 老師週末給我們出了很多作業。

items.stem: The _____ age for driving a car in Taiwan is 18.
items.exZh: 在臺灣考汽車駕照的最低年齡是十八歲。

items.stem: The teacher _____ a new game to help us learn vocabulary.
items.exZh: 老師設計了一個新遊戲幫我們學單字。

items.stem: The game will go on _____ of the weather.
items.exZh: 不論天氣如何，比賽都會照常進行。

items.stem: The coach _____ the video to find our team's mistakes.
items.exZh: 教練分析比賽影片，找出我們隊的失誤。

items.stem: The school _____ more money to science equipment this year.
items.exZh: 學校今年撥了更多經費給科學設備。

items.stem: He felt _____ when his boss criticized him in front of everyone.
items.exZh: 老闆當眾批評他，讓他覺得很丟臉。

items.stem: Dust had _____ on the shelves while we were away.
items.exZh: 我們不在家時，架子上積了灰塵。

items.stem: Water can be split into its _____ elements, hydrogen and oxygen.
items.exZh: 水可以分解成它的組成元素：氫和氧。

items.stem: The building was designed for both practical and _____ reasons.
items.exZh: 這棟建築的設計兼顧實用與美觀。
